prompt: A high-end web application interface for 'Rial Scope' USD/IRR Exchange Rate Explorer styled as a Jet-Age ticket wallet with a horizontal multi-coupon tabbed deck. Crisp off-white cardstock (#f8fafc) with navy blue borders (#0f172a), stamped red 'VALID' and 'FALLBACK' official ink stamps (#dc2626), carbon-copy tabular numbers, perforated tear-off top tabs for 'Revalue Amount', 'USD Converter', 'Compare Prices', and 'History Explorer'. The active coupon expands into an ultra-structured calculation matrix with ticket notch cutouts, official airport/market routing codes, and high-density currency conversion figures. Swiss typography, brutalist hairline rules, physical coupon texture.
